method: Coherence: rubric of GUIDE.md section 4.2 (0 = cut mid-idea / missing subject so not understandable; 1 = partly understandable, missing context; 2 = self-contained, keeps the whole idea). Grounding: GUIDE.md 4.4 on the 3 retrieved chunks together (0 = no evidence; 1 = evidence present but missing a needed condition/context; 2 = enough to answer and trace the source). Metadata: compare source/page/chapter/section of each test top-3 record with the raw PDF page (8-word probe from the middle of the chunk must occur on that physical page) and with the section headings on the page.
bias_note: The labeler also wrote the pipeline and the benchmark and saw the automatic Hit@k before labeling, so labels are not blind; strategy C coherence equals B by construction (identical chunks).
